COMMENT: This file demonstrates the PROJECT DATA MAPPING format for charter adaptation.
COMMENT_2: Each key is a value that EXISTS in the template DOCX (old/previous project value).
COMMENT_3: Each value is what it should be REPLACED with (new project value).
COMMENT_4: Do NOT use {{PLACEHOLDER}} format — the template contains real text from a previous project.
COMMENT_5: Only include mappings for fields you want to REPLACE. Omit fields you want to keep.
COMMENT_6: This file should be customized for each new project and saved as: results/projectHITs/[ProjectName]_data.json
Relatório de Análise: Relatório de Requisitos e Arquitetura Detalhada
Plano de Testes: Plano de Testes Integrado e Relatório de Cobertura

_NOTES.RIGID_FIELDS: Table structures, fonts, heading styles, proformas, legal text — these are NEVER replaced by the script
_NOTES.VARIABLE_FIELDS: Project name, team, budget, dates, deliverables, etc. — list all values to replace here
_NOTES.ADAPTIVE_FIELDS: Generic assumptions, methodology, risks — can be optimized but not replaced by script; provide as separate instruction
